info.name: MLOps Monorepo APIs
info.description:
Postman collection for the MLOps monorepo serving APIs (27 total services):

## ML/RL/NN APIs (ports 8000-8019)
- **Pizza Price Prediction API** (Linear Regression) - predicts pizza price from diameter
- **Spam Email Classification API** (Logistic Regression) - classifies emails as SPAM or NOT spam
- **Market Segmentation API** (K-Means Clustering) - segments customers into behavioral groups
- **Recommendation Engine API** (Apriori) - generates product recommendations from transaction patterns
- **Anomaly Detection API** (PCA) - detects anomalous server metrics using dimensionality reduction
- **Robot Maze Navigation API** (Q-Learning) - navigates a robot through a maze using reinforcement learning
- **Semi-Supervised Email Classification API** (Self-Training) - classifies emails with limited labeled data
- **Self-Supervised Monitoring API** (Contrastive Learning) - detects anomalies without labels
- **Email Spam Detection NN** (Feedforward NN) - neural network spam classifier
- **House Price Prediction NN** (Feedforward NN) - neural network regressor
- **Credit Card Fraud Detection NN** (Feedforward NN) - fraud detection neural network
- **Handwritten Digit Recognition NN** (Feedforward NN) - digit classifier
- **Language Translation RNN** (Seq2Seq RNN) - translates text between languages
- **Sentiment Analysis RNN** (LSTM) - classifies text sentiment
- **Text Generation RNN** (Transformer RNN) - autoregressive text generation
- **Speech Recognition RNN** (LSTM) - converts speech to text
- **Music Generation RNN** (LSTM) - generates musical sequences
- **Stock Market Prediction RNN** (LSTM) - predicts stock prices
- **Weather Forecasting RNN** (LSTM) - forecasts weather
- **Image Captioning RNN** (Attention RNN) - generates captions for images

## Generative-AI APIs (ports 8020-8026)
- **Code Generation API** (Transformer) - code completion, text-to-code, refactoring, bug scanning, test generation
- **Image Generation API** (Diffusion + VAE) - text-to-image generation
- **Prompt Engineering API** (Template-based) - zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, self-ask, least-to-most prompting
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation API** (RAG) - TF-IDF retrieval with grounded generation
- **Text Generation API** (Transformer) - autoregressive generation with temperature/top-k/top-p sampling
- **Tool Use and Functional Calling API** (Function Calling) - stock prices, weather, calculator, order status, SQL queries
- **Video Generation API** (Spatiotemporal Diffusion) - text-to-video and image-to-video generation

## Setup

1. Run all APIs locally:
   ```bash
   make serve-all   # Starts all 27 APIs on ports 8000-8026
   ```
   Or individually:
   ```bash
   make serve-pizza                     # http://localhost:8000
   make serve-spam                      # http://localhost:8001
   make serve-code-generation           # http://localhost:8020
   make serve-prompt-engineering        # http://localhost:8022
   make serve-tool-use                  # http://localhost:8025
   ```
2. Or port-forward from Kubernetes:
   ```bash
   make k8s-port-forward-pizza          # http://localhost:8080
   make k8s-port-forward-spam           # http://localhost:8081
   ```
3. Update the collection variables to match your environment.
